# kiln4py

The Python re-implementation of the KILN roasting-plant model: one package per subsystem, each
validated against serialized Fortran output before it is allowed to replace anything.

A product is a container and nothing else. It carries no owner, no dates, no appetite and no
cycle — the projects under it carry all of that, and the pitches under those carry the bets. What
it buys is the one thing a directory could not: work in the model can be written down as waiting
on work in the DSL underneath it, because both codebases are described in the same plan.

Under it: `proj-7e57a0`, which is the placeholder parent the older half of this corpus hangs from.
